Calculate logbook reporting coverage against ACE catch estimates

calculate_logbook_coverage.Rd

Compares logbook-reported catch against ACE (aggregated catch estimate) catch for the same flag/gear/species/year strata, and calculates the proportional shortfall of logbook catch relative to ACE catch.

Usage

calculate_logbook_coverage(
  in_wcpfc = TRUE,
  year = NULL,
  flag = NULL,
  gear = NULL,
  species = NULL,
  exclude_flag = NULL,
  exclude_gear = NULL,
  exclude_species = NULL,
  group_species = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

in_wcpfc

Optional logical. If not NULL, restricts sum_ace() to the "WX" ocean code and is passed through to logbook_catch() as its WCPFC-area filter; if NULL, no ocean filter is applied.

year

Optional numeric vector of years to filter by.

flag

Optional character vector of flag codes to filter by.

gear

Optional character vector of gear codes to filter by (passed to logbook_catch(); sum_ace() is not filtered by gear).

species

Optional character vector of species codes to filter by.

group_species

Logical. If TRUE, catch is summed across all species within each remaining grouping (i.e. SP_CODE is dropped before summarising). Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A tibble of ace_catch, logbook_catch, and coverage ((ace_catch - logbook_catch) / ace_catch) by flag, year, species (unless group_species = TRUE), and gear.

Details

ace_catch is obtained via get_ace() and logbook_catch via get_logbook_catch(), using the same flag/gear/species/year filters. The two are full_join()ed so that strata present in only one source are retained, with missing catch values filled to zero via tidyr::replace_na(). If group_species = TRUE, logbook_catch is re-summed across species (SP_CODE dropped from the grouping); a coverage column is then calculated as the proportional difference between ACE and logbook catch.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
calculate_logbook_coverage(in_wcpfc = TRUE)
calculate_logbook_coverage(in_wcpfc = TRUE, group_species = TRUE)
} # }
